mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.status, a.is_top AS isTop, a.is_hot AS isHot, COALESCE(a.view_num, 0) AS viewNum, COALESCE(like_stats.like_num, 0) AS likeNum, COALESCE(comment_stats.comment_num, 0) AS commentNum, a.words_num AS wordsNum, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime, a.publish_time AS publishTime, a.sort, u.nickname AS userNickname, u.avatar AS userAvatar, category.name AS category FROM article a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category ON a.category_id = category.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) AS like_num FROM user_like WHERE target_type = 0 AND delete_flag = 0 GROUP BY target_id ) like_stats ON like_stats.target_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT source_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_num FROM `comment` WHERE type = 0 AND delete_flag = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY source_id ) comment_stats ON comment_stats.source_id = a.id WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status IN (1, 3) AND ( COALESCE(a.is_top, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(a.is_hot, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(a.view_num, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(like_stats.like_num, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(comment_stats.comment_num, 0) > 0 ) ORDER BY COALESCE(a.is_top, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.is_hot, 0) DESC, (COALESCE(like_stats.like_num, 0) + COALESCE(comment_stats.comment_num, 0)) DESC, COALESCE(a.view_num, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.publish_time, a.create_time) DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS articleTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS dailyTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS userTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `comment` WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS commentTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS linkTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_like WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS likeTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= CURDATE()) AS todayNewUser, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND audit_status = 0) AS linkPending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND audit_status = 2) AS linkRejected, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND audit_status = 1) AS linkApproved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS categoryTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS tagTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `comment` WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND status = 0) AS commentPending, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(view_num), 0) FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS viewTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_view_record WHERE create_time >= CURDATE()) AS todayView, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) FROM article_view_record WHERE create_time >= CURDATE()) AS todayVisitor, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) FROM article_view_record) AS totalVisitor

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS articleCount, IFNULL(SUM(a.view_num), 0) AS totalView, COUNT(CASE WHEN avr.create_time >= CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS todayView, COUNT(DISTINCT avr.id) AS totalVisitor # COUNT(DISTINCT avr.ip_address) AS totalVisitor FROM article a LEFT JOIN article_view_record avr ON a.id = avr.article_id WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status IN (1, 3);
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{format}) AS period, COUNT(*) AS count FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period
